Support to Media and Law Studies Association

description.narrative:
The impact of the proposed project is
Increased legal accountability and protection for freedom of expression in Türkiye, contributing to a freer civic space, an independent media environment, and greater resilience against repression.
Medium-term objective of the project is to strengthen the protection of freedom of expression in Turkiye
Short term outcomes are as follows:
1) Increased legal protection for journalists and civil society actors facing prosecution for their journalistic work and in violation with their freedom of expression and aided by MLSA in Turkiye
2) Increased transparency and accountability in free speech trials of journalists and HRDs in Turkiye
3) Consistent documentation of online censorship targeting news and civil society content in Turkey enables data-driven responses and legally challenging unlawful internet censorship orders
4) Sustained international advocacy for accountability in freedom of expression cases in Turkiye
